newsitem.title: FRANCE: Truckers blockade fuel depots in southwest France.
newsitem.headline: Truckers blockade fuel depots in southwest France.

text.p: A day of protest by French truckers disrupted fuel deliveries in southwestern France on Monday as drivers blockaded two depots serving Bordeaux, unions said.

Parked lorries straddled three roads and prevented oil company tankers reaching two key depots at Brassens, on the outskirts of the city. But passenger cars and other light vehicles were allowed through.
There were no reports of shortages at petrol stations, which had about four weeks' notice of the disruption.
Four unions called the one-day protest last month after accusing employers of backing out of a deal that ended a crippling 12-day truck strike across France last November.
The government-backed agreement called for truckers to be allowed to retire at 55 instead of 60.
But talks about implementing the deal broke down when unions and haulage bosses failed to meet a March 31 deadline.
